changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.11[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Real-Debrid[/COLOR]
-Check RD cached torrents now comes switched off. Since Debrid Media Manager stopped answering add-ons, it only works with your own DMM sponsor key; switched on without one it did nothing.
-The DMM API key sits right under it in Accounts > Real-Debrid and shows as soon as you switch it on, instead of at the end of the Real-Debrid section once authorized.
-Switched on without a key, Real-Debrid results are checked when played, as with it off, and luc_kodi tells you once that the setting needs the key.
-On updating it is switched off once where it was on without a key. If you had entered a DMM key, it stays on.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-The labels of Check RD cached torrents and RD 2026 keyword-filter compliance now come from the language files, like the rest of the settings.
